messages.content: 今天美國的黃金價格是多少？

function.name: calculate_Bond_Price
function.description: Calculate the bond price given the face value, coupon rate, required rate of return, and maturity period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。若想知道今天美國的黃金價格，建議您參考以下幾個可靠來源：

| 平台 | 連結 | 特色 |
|------|------|------|
| **Bloomberg** | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets | 提供即時行情、新聞與分析 |
| **Kitco** | https://www.kitco.com/ | 專門報導貴金屬價格，更新頻率高 |
| **Reuters** | https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities | 全球金融新聞與即時價格 |
| **GoldPrice.org** | https://goldprice.org/ | 以美元為基礎的即時黃金價格 |
| **Yahoo! Finance** | https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/GC=F/ | 可查看黃金期貨合約價格 |

在這些網站上，您通常可以看到「Spot Gold」或「Gold Futures」的即時價格，並且會標示為「USD per troy ounce」。如果您需要更精確的數字（例如小數點後兩位），請直接點擊相應的行情頁面。祝您查詢順利！
message.reasoning: User asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" They want today's gold price in US. We need to provide current gold price. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. We can suggest checking reliable sources. We can also provide a typical price range. But we should not fabricate. So answer: I don't have real-time data. Suggest checking websites like Bloomberg, Kitco, etc.
